Privacy Policy

Last updated: [DATE]

Seal Accident Group ("we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect through https://sealaccidentgroup.com (the "Site"), how we use it, and your choices.

Information we collect

When you submit our case-review form or contact us, we may collect:

  • Contact details you provide: name, phone number, and email address.
  • Information about your potential claim: when an accident occurred, whether anyone was injured, and any details you choose to share.
  • Technical data automatically collected, such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited, including through cookies or similar technologies.

How we use your information

  • To respond to your inquiry and evaluate your potential case.
  • To contact you by phone, text, or email about your request, with your consent.
  • To improve the Site and our services.
  • To comply with legal obligations.

Text and call consent (TCPA)

By submitting the form and checking the consent box, you agree that we may contact you at the phone number provided by call or text, including via automated means, about your inquiry. Consent is not a condition of any purchase. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying STOP to a text or asking us to stop contacting you.

How we share information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with service providers who help us operate the Site and our intake process (for example, hosting and email delivery), and as required by law. Submitting this form does not create an attorney-client relationship.

Cookies

The Site may use cookies and similar technologies for functionality and analytics. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

Data security

We use reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, however, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Your choices and rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us at admin@sealaccidentgroup.com. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under laws such as the CCPA (California) or GDPR (EU).

Children's privacy

The Site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "last updated" date above reflects the most recent version.
